NodeService（Python）

The normal dictionary return value will contain status, and success is usually 0; if the server returns a non-0 status, SDK will throw AtomApiError.

New parameter format

The main graph node interface now uses parameter objects uniformly. Please import the required parameter class from atom_sdk first: See: Python 参数对象 for complete field descriptions.

from atom_sdk import (
    ChangeNodeIOParams,
    CopyNodeParams,
    CreateNodeParams,
    CreateDynamicNodeParams,
    CreateGraphNodeParams,
    EditNodeCommentParams,
    GenerateGraphNodeByNodesParams,
    NodeBindingUpdate,
    NodeConnectionParams,
    NodeParamUpdate,
    NodeRef,
    PortRef,
)

In this way, users do not need to remember the order of multiple string parameters, especially for interfaces such as connection, parameter setting, and binding that are easily reversed.

method Parameter object

create_node

CreateNodeParams

create_dynamic_io_node

CreateDynamicNodeParams

create_node_by_copy

CopyNodeParams

change_node_io

ChangeNodeIOParams

create_graph_node

CreateGraphNodeParams

generate_graph_node_by_nodes

GenerateGraphNodeByNodesParams

delete_node / get_node_params / get_node_info_in_graph / activate_node / initial_node / update_node

NodeRef

connect_nodes / disconnect_nodes

NodeConnectionParams

get_node_port_data / get_points_data / get_points_data_parsed / download_data

PortRef

set_node_param_data

NodeParamUpdate

set_binding_name

NodeBindingUpdate

edit_node_comment

EditNodeCommentParams

Recommended calling order

client.graph.open_graph(graph_name)      <- Open the picture first,SDK cache timestamp
        |
  node.create_node(CreateNodeParams(...))     <- Create node,get node_id
        |
  node.set_node_param_data(NodeParamUpdate(...))
        |
  node.connect_nodes(NodeConnectionParams(...))
        |
  node.set_binding_name(NodeBindingUpdate(...))
        |
  node.activate_node(NodeRef(...)) / client.graph.run_graph(graph_name)

Interface detailed explanation

create_node(params)

Create a node in the main graph.

Parameter Object:
CreateNodeParams

field type Description

graph_name

str

Main image name

node_name

str

Node class name, must be a node type registered on the server

Return value: dict[str, Any], usually includes status, nodeId, currentIndex, timestamp.

from atom_sdk import CreateNodeParams

result = client.node.create_node(CreateNodeParams("my_graph", "DetectAndSegment"))
print("Request status:", result["status"])
node_id = result["nodeId"]

create_node_by_copy(params)

Copy existing nodes in the main graph.

Parameter Object:
CopyNodeParams

field type Description

graph_name

str

Main image name

node_name

str

New node name after copying

node_id

str

The copied source node ID

 
from atom_sdk import CopyNodeParams

result = client.node.create_node_by_copy(
    CopyNodeParams("my_graph", "DetectAndSegment", "source_node_id")
)
print("Request status:", result["status"])
print("Node after copying ID:", result["nodeId"])

create_dynamic_io_node(params)

Create a node with dynamic input and output definitions.

from atom_sdk import CreateDynamicNodeParams

result = client.node.create_dynamic_io_node(
    CreateDynamicNodeParams(
        "my_graph",
        "DynamicIONode",
        {"outputs": [{"name": "mask_out", "dtype": "BinaryImage"}]},
    )
)
print(result["nodeId"])

change_node_io(params)

Modify the input and output definition of a dynamic node.

from atom_sdk import ChangeNodeIOParams

client.node.change_node_io(
    ChangeNodeIOParams(
        "my_graph",
        "node_id",
        {"outputs": [{"name": "score_out", "dtype": "Float"}]},
    )
)

create_graph_node(params)

Create graph node based on existing subgraphs.

from atom_sdk import CreateGraphNodeParams

result = client.node.create_graph_node(
    CreateGraphNodeParams("my_graph", "WrappedSubgraph", "subgraph_template")
)
print(result["nodeId"])

generate_graph_node_by_nodes(params)

Pack multiple nodes into new graph node.

from atom_sdk import GenerateGraphNodeByNodesParams

result = client.node.generate_graph_node_by_nodes(
    GenerateGraphNodeByNodesParams("my_graph", "GroupedSubgraph", ["node_a", "node_b"])
)
print(result["nodeId"])

delete_node(params)

Delete a node in the main graph.

Parameter Object:
NodeRef

from atom_sdk import NodeRef

client.node.delete_node(NodeRef("my_graph", "node_id"))

connect_nodes(params)

The port connecting two nodes.

Parameter Object:
NodeConnectionParams

field type Description

graph_name

str

Main image name

output_node_id

str

Source node ID, which is the node that generates data

output_port_name

str

Source node output port name

input_node_id

str

Target node ID, which is the node that receives data

input_port_name

str

Target node input port name

Memory method: output_* in front, input_* in back. The data flow direction is output → input.

 
from atom_sdk import NodeConnectionParams

client.node.connect_nodes(
    NodeConnectionParams(
        graph_name="my_graph",
        output_node_id="node_a_id",
        output_port_name="image_out",
        input_node_id="node_b_id",
        input_port_name="image_in",
    )
)

disconnect_nodes(params)

Disconnect the connection between two nodes. The parameter object is exactly the same as connect_nodes.

from atom_sdk import NodeConnectionParams

client.node.disconnect_nodes(
    NodeConnectionParams(
        "my_graph",
        "node_a_id",
        "image_out",
        "node_b_id",
        "image_in",
    )
)

get_node_params(params)

Get a snapshot of the node’s current parameter values.

Parameter Object:
NodeRef The return value usually contains:

field Description

init_params

Initialize parameter dictionary

run_params

Run parameter dictionary

 
from atom_sdk import NodeRef

params = client.node.get_node_params(NodeRef("my_graph", "node_id"))
print(params.get("run_params"))

get_node_info_in_graph(params)

Get complete information about a node in the graph, including parameters, port definitions, policy configuration, etc.

Parameter Object:
NodeRef

from atom_sdk import NodeRef

info = client.node.get_node_info_in_graph(NodeRef("my_graph", "node_id"))
print(info.get("nodeInfo", {}).get("inputs"))

get_node_port_data(params)

Get the current data of a certain port of the node.

Parameter Object:
PortRef

field type Description

graph_name

str

Picture name

node_id

str

Node ID

port_name

str

Port name

io_type

str

port direction, usually "inputs" or "outputs"

 
from atom_sdk import PortRef

data = client.node.get_node_port_data(
    PortRef("my_graph", "node_id", "result_image", "outputs")
)
print(data)

get_points_data_parsed(params)

Read and parse node point clouds. Ordinary users give priority to using this interface.

Parameter Object:
PortRef

from atom_sdk import PortRef

clouds = client.node.get_points_data_parsed(
    PortRef("my_graph", "node_id", "point_cloud_out", "outputs")
)
print(clouds[0].shape)
print(clouds[0].tolist()[:2])

get_points_data(params)

Read the raw point cloud byte stream of the node port.

Parameter Object:
PortRef Return value: bytes Note: What is returned here is Atom custom binary point cloud payload, not a simple float32 array. When using point cloud results normally, get_points_data_parsed(…​) is preferred.

from atom_sdk import PortRef

raw = client.node.get_points_data(
    PortRef("my_graph", "node_id", "point_cloud_out", "outputs")
)
print(len(raw))

download_data(params)

Generate a server download link for a certain port result.

from atom_sdk import PortRef

result = client.node.download_data(
    PortRef("my_graph", "node_id", "point_cloud_out", "outputs")
)
print(result["url"])

set_node_param_data(params)

Set node parameters.

Parameter Object:
NodeParamUpdate

field type Description

graph_name

str

Picture name

node_id

str

Node ID

param_name

str

Parameter name

param_type

str

parameter type, usually "init_params" or "run_params"

value

Any

parameter value; when pathlib.Path is passed in, SDK will automatically upload as a file

 
from pathlib import Path
from atom_sdk import NodeParamUpdate

client.node.set_node_param_data(
    NodeParamUpdate(
        "my_graph",
        "node_id",
        "confidence",
        "run_params",
        0.75,
    )
)

client.node.set_node_param_data(
    NodeParamUpdate(
        "my_graph",
        "node_id",
        "config_file",
        "init_params",
        Path("/configs/detect_config.json"),
    )
)

set_binding_name(params)

Set the externally exposed binding name for the node’s port or parameter.

Parameter Object:
NodeBindingUpdate

field type Description

graph_name

str

Picture name

node_id

str

Node ID

binding_type

str

"inputs", "outputs", "init_params" or "run_params"

origin_name

str

Original port name or parameter name

binding_name

str

New binding name; passing an empty string usually means canceling the binding

 
from atom_sdk import NodeBindingUpdate

client.node.set_binding_name(
    NodeBindingUpdate(
        "my_graph",
        "node_id",
        "outputs",
        "result",
        "detect_result",
    )
)

edit_node_comment(params)

Modify node remarks.

from atom_sdk import EditNodeCommentParams

client.node.edit_node_comment(EditNodeCommentParams("my_graph", "node_id", "This is a new note"))

activate_node(params, *, timeout_seconds=30)

Starting from the specified node, activate the node and its downstream nodes, automatically polling internally until completion or waiting timeout.

Parameter Object:
NodeRef

from atom_sdk import NodeRef

result = client.node.activate_node(NodeRef("my_graph", "node_id"), timeout_seconds=120)
print("Complete:", result.get("finish"))

timeout_seconds=None means waiting until the server returns completion or error.

initial_node(params)

Initialize a node, such as loading a model and reading configuration.

Parameter Object:
NodeRef

from atom_sdk import NodeRef

result = client.node.initial_node(NodeRef("my_graph", "node_id"))
print("Initialization successful:", result.get("success"))

update_node(params)

Update a single node. This interface is only requested once, and the finish status returned by the server will be handed over to the user as it is.

Parameter Object:
NodeRef

from atom_sdk import NodeRef

result = client.node.update_node(NodeRef("my_graph", "node_id"))
print("Is this return completed?:", result.get("finish"))

Complete example

from atom_sdk import (
    AtomClient,
    CreateNodeParams,
    NodeBindingUpdate,
    NodeConnectionParams,
    NodeParamUpdate,
    NodeRef,
    PortRef,
)

client = AtomClient(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:10026")
GRAPH_NAME = "pipeline_graph"

client.graph.open_graph(GRAPH_NAME)

source = client.node.create_node(CreateNodeParams(GRAPH_NAME, "ImageLoadNode"))
print("Source node creation request status:", source["status"])
source_id = source["nodeId"]

detect = client.node.create_node(CreateNodeParams(GRAPH_NAME, "DetectAndSegment"))
print("Detect node creation request status:", detect["status"])
detect_id = detect["nodeId"]

client.node.set_node_param_data(
    NodeParamUpdate(GRAPH_NAME, detect_id, "model", "init_params", "/models/yolov8n.onnx")
)
client.node.set_node_param_data(
    NodeParamUpdate(GRAPH_NAME, detect_id, "threshold", "run_params", 0.6)
)

client.node.connect_nodes(
    NodeConnectionParams(GRAPH_NAME, source_id, "image_out", detect_id, "image")
)

client.node.set_binding_name(
    NodeBindingUpdate(GRAPH_NAME, detect_id, "outputs", "results", "detect_result")
)

result = client.node.activate_node(NodeRef(GRAPH_NAME, source_id))
print("Activation completed:", result.get("finish"))

output_data = client.node.get_node_port_data(
    PortRef(GRAPH_NAME, detect_id, "results", "outputs")
)
print("Test results:", output_data)
